title: [Extensibility Request] issue 30424: add prepayment update event
summary: A handled integration event was added to allow extensions to control prepayment amount updates when correcting posted sales invoices.
key_points: Handled integration event added in UpdateSalesOrderLinePrepmtAmount, before prepayment amounts are updated
Fires after currency initialization in the Correct Posted Sales Invoice codeunit
Subscribers can set it as handled to skip the standard prepayment amount updates
Added in the W1, APAC and ES layers
quote: Extensions need a supported way to prevent sales order prepayment amounts from being restored when correcting a posted sales invoice.
